_comment: Copy to vps-registry.json (gitignored) and mount it into the container (VPS_REGISTRY_FILE or /app/vps-registry.json). Private overlay for the VPS ops dashboard: friendly names/descriptions/domains per /opt/<dir> key, umbrella folding, hidden infra keys, and cron display metadata. All fields optional — a missing file just means generic auto-discovered display.

my-platform.name: My Platform
my-platform.description: Folds sibling compose projects my-platform-web + my-platform-db into one card (longest key-prefix match).

my-app-workers.name: My App workers
my-app-workers.description: Containers My App spawns at runtime instead of declaring in compose. Pulled out of the containers table and Systems & Apps onto a card of their own. Every given regex (name, image) must match; the first matching pool wins.

meta.title: Nightly job
meta.description: What the cron entry matching this regex actually does.

jobs.title: Queue worker
jobs.description: Scheduler that runs inside the app's own process (not host cron).
